# UMass Global

> UMass Global offers WASC-accredited online degree programs and professional development for working adults across multiple educational levels, from associate degrees through doctoral programs.

UMass Global is a fully online university serving working professionals with flexible, self-paced learning options. The institution operates multiple schools including Arts & Sciences, Business & Professional Studies, Education, and Health & Behavioral Sciences, with a strong focus on California teaching credentials and workforce development.

## Key Topics

- Online Education
- Accreditation (WASCUC)
- Professional Development
- Working Adults
- Career Advancement
- Teacher Credentials
- Graduate Programs
- Certificate Programs
- Financial Aid
- Admissions
- Social Work
- Educational Leadership
- Continuing Education
- MyPath Learning Platform
- California Credentials

## Degree Programs

- [Online Bachelor's Degree Programs at UMass Global](https://www.umassglobal.edu/academic-programs/bachelors-degrees): 17 bachelor's programs with 28+ concentrations in business, criminal justice, psychology
- [Master's Degrees](https://www.umassglobal.edu/academic-programs/masters-degrees): 20 master's degree programs for working adults in business, education, social work
- [Doctoral Degrees](https://www.umassglobal.edu/academic-programs/doctoral-degrees): Professional doctorate programs: Ed.D., DNP, Doctor of Social Work
- [Online Associate Degree Programs at UMass Global](https://www.umassglobal.edu/academic-programs/associate-degrees): Associate degree programs with self-paced online learning and transfer credits

## Admissions & Application

- [UMass Global Online Application](https://www.umassglobal.edu/forms/umass-global-online-application): Online application portal for new and returning applicants to UMass Global
- [UMass Global | Accredited Online Degree Programs](https://www.umassglobal.edu): UMass Global homepage: accredited online degree programs and professional development

## Schools & Academic Departments

- [Health & Behavioral Sciences](https://www.umassglobal.edu/health-behavioral-sciences): School of Health & Behavioral Sciences: psychology, counseling, social work programs
- [Education](https://www.umassglobal.edu/education): School of Education: California teaching credentials and education programs
- [Arts & Sciences](https://www.umassglobal.edu/arts-sciences): School of Arts and Sciences: criminal justice, liberal studies, applied studies
- [Public & Nonprofit Leadership - Online Graduate Certificate Program](https://www.umassglobal.edu/business-professional-studies): School of Business: graduate certificate in public and nonprofit leadership

## Certificates & Professional Credentials

- [Certificate Programs & Courses](https://www.umassglobal.edu/academic-programs/certificates-and-courses): Certificate and professional development programs for career advancement
- [Credentials & Authorizations](https://www.umassglobal.edu/academic-programs/credentials-and-authorizations): CTC-accredited California teaching credentials and service authorizations

## Resources & Support

- [Extended Education](https://www.umassglobal.edu/extended-education): Extended Education: corporate training, workforce development, continuing education
- [Academic Catalog](https://catalog.umassglobal.edu): Chancellor's message and academic catalog from admissions to graduation
- [Events Center](https://www.umassglobal.edu/landing-pages/outreach-events): Events calendar with webinars, info sessions, and registration for outreach
